status_detail: Richland City Council approved an option agreement in December 2025 for 275 acres at 2100 Horn Rapids Road; Atlas Agro proposed five roughly 500,000-square-foot data center buildings with an estimated $500 million cost and construction anticipated around 2027.
notes: Official utility public comments in Benton PUD's 2026 resource-plan resolution also refer to Atlas Agro Data Center Campus as one of two planned Benton County data centers.

project_name: Trammell Crow Lewis & Clark Ranch Data Center
status_detail: West Richland changed zoning to permit data centers in Urban Transition and Light Industrial districts after an application by Frank Tiegs LLC. Local reporting says Trammell Crow is studying a data center campus on part of Lewis & Clark Ranch, initially 500 acres and potentially 1,000 acres; interconnection tracker lists West Richland Data Center Campus at 250+ MW proposed.
notes: Capacity is from interconnection tracker's 250+ MW listing, rounded to 250. Project name/developer from local business reporting; official West Richland records show enabling zoning rather than a final project permit.

project_name: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory On-Premises Next-Gen AI Compute Data Center
aliases: PNNL on-premises next-gen AI compute data center
developer: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory / Battelle / U.S. Department of Energy
status_detail: PNNL/Battelle issued an RFI for a scalable on-premises AI compute data center in Richland, with initial production readiness around 2 MW by 2028 and possible expansion up to 40 MW.
notes: SAM.gov/RFI is treated as primary evidence for the announced solicitation; 40 MW is maximum future expansion cited by the RFI coverage/tracker.

aliases: Microsoft data center campus in Malaga
status_detail: Chelan County hearing examiner documents in June 2023 approved site preparation/phased construction of Microsoft data center buildings and a supporting switchyard in Malaga. Chelan PUD approved contract terms in June 2025 to power Microsoft's Malaga campus; local reporting said contractors had begun demolition in 2023 and Microsoft was expected to break ground in 2026.
notes: Official county/PUD sources confirm the campus and approvals. Capacity is from tracker summaries for the Malaga campus, not directly from the county CUP text.
